p2_issues.root_cause: The validated production runtime evolved to .venv-cuda plus an absolute offline reranker snapshot, but README and .env.example still describe the generic .venv path and default the reranker off.
p2_issues.impact: Current-machine startup works; new-machine or fresh-setup recovery requires repository archaeology.
p2_issues.minimal_fix_recommendation: In the later README/Architecture phase, document the CUDA launcher, .venv-cuda provisioning contract, required model revision/path, and production .env keys; align safe example defaults without embedding a machine-specific secret or path.

p2_issues.root_cause: The UI brand was changed to LearnPilot while README, backend app/OpenAPI defaults, and the frontend package name retained PersonalLearning identifiers.
p2_issues.impact: A recruiter inspecting README or /docs sees inconsistent product naming, but the application workflows remain functional.
p2_issues.minimal_fix_recommendation: Align non-persistent display/release metadata during the README/Architecture phase; do not rename database/schema identifiers unless separately justified.

p2_issues.root_cause: Long-running visual and RAG research accumulated temporary model copies, incomplete downloads, ONNX exports, browser profiles, runtime copies, and superseded reports.
p2_issues.impact: The repository workspace is noisy and consumes substantial disk, but no runtime or data-integrity failure is caused by the debris.
p2_issues.minimal_fix_recommendation: Execute the scoped repository_cleanup_plan with explicit keep/delete lists and post-cleanup regression checks.

documented_limitations.reason: One of five fixed DeepSeek generations omitted one supported branch while remaining partially correct, citation-ID-valid and free of unsupported fabrication; no stable severe normal-use failure was proven.
